Metadata.title: What the fuck do I actually want?
Metadata.description: A private guided reflection for separating what matters from what merely looks important.

Common.privacy: Your reflections can be deeply personal. We only use them to generate your result.

Landing.intro1: You spend years optimizing your life.
Landing.intro3: But when did you last ask whether you're optimizing for a life you actually want?

evidence.title: Look at evidence
evidence.description: Real moments when you felt alive, not abstract values you think you should choose.

noise.title: Cut through noise
noise.description: Separate what you want from what parents, status, LinkedIn, or Instagram taught you to want.

price.title: Pay the price
price.description: Choose between competing goods. Every life has a cost; vague preference is cheap.

action.title: Do one real thing
action.description: Turn the pattern into a reversible experiment and a next action small enough to begin.

Landing.closeEyebrow: A SERIOUS QUESTION. A USEFUL ANSWER.
Landing.success: Not what success looks like online.
Landing.feel: What do you want your life to feel like?
Landing.disclaimer: This is guided reflection, not psychological diagnosis, therapy, or crisis support.

Commitment.title: Give this 20 minutes.
Commitment.line3: Don't answer as the person you think you should be.
Commitment.privateCopy: Your progress is saved under an anonymous ID. No account, ads, or tracking scripts.

Results.safetyTitle: Your safety matters more than this result.
Results.generateError: We couldn't generate your Compass. Your answers are still saved; try again.
Results.heroCopy: This isn't who you are. It's our best interpretation of what you told us. Keep what feels true. Challenge what doesn't.
Results.tensionsCopy: Not problems to eliminate. Conditions your life may need to hold at the same time.
Results.influencesTitle: What may not be entirely yours
Results.directionsCopy: None of these is “your perfect life.” They are places to collect better evidence.
Results.goalsTitle: What you may be asking the goal to provide
Results.transitionCopy: Understanding what you want is useful. But you won't think your way into a different life.
Results.planCopy: Choose one direction. Run a small test. Learn from reality instead of asking thought to produce certainty.
Results.nowHint: Something small enough for the next 24 hours
Results.motivation: MAKE A PLAN FOR THE MOMENT MOTIVATION DISAPPEARS
